trailhead.label: Saint-Honoré 1500 resort car park on the D 115c, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpages: sheep and cattle graze the heights in summer, often with guard dogs (patous); keep your dog on a lead and walk round the flock.
Open ridge at about 1,500–2,100 m with little shade and quick weather changes.
Snow can linger on the crests early and late in the season.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
